intent: Actual high-volume curation, not list expansion: distinguish first-party checkpoint formats in five current canonical high-volume model repositories and propose one format per capability where possible.
source_evidence: Live official HF Hub immutable revision trees as published; GitHub canonical v2 repository size baseline independently compared. No model bytes downloaded, gated access attempted or code run.

aggregate.safe_claim: Exact logical path sums, not demonstrated functional equivalence, replacement precision or final offline archive savings.

decisions.hard_reason: Both configurations may represent different native formats; provenance and tensor/value comparison required before permanently omitting either.
The official README points to original/ for the native gpt_oss code; direct HF or Metal inference requires a separately justified variant. Original and HF format equivalence is unverified.
The standalone transformer/autoencoder appear to overlap the Diffusers weight components but may use another packing. Gated and noncommercial terms must be independently accepted.
No observed duplicate full weight set, model is manual Gated. Cannot replace 217GB original with unapproved lossy quantization for research.
Only one original 40-shard set observed; size cannot be reduced by file omission. Selection can be postponed without asserting that other models match its capability.

format_checks_required: For parallel formats compare tensors/quantization headers and their public original training/release provenance before treating as interchangeable.
For root model-index keep exact model shard lists, tokenizer and processor and source LICENSE/USAGE_POLICY/NOTICE where present.

For image diffusion confirm standalone vs Diffusers transformer is functionally interchangeable at the same declared dtype; text_encoder and VAE cannot be omitted just because the transformer flat weight exists.
For original gpt_oss confirm native gpt_oss reference format and the tools needed for Harmony without changing protected original tensors.
For any hard-gated repo enforce user-held permission. Metadata visibility is NOT authorization to acquire file contents.
No selected model can be promoted to approved until full required dependencies, exact bytes, runtime security and hardware RAM have been separately resolved.

records.reason: HF model-00001..00003 and model.safetensors.index.json plus tokenizer/processor provenance; consolidated seven-shard layout is a separate upstream packaging, NOT proven identical or safely discardable.

Keep publisher's original/ seven-shard model for original-research provenance, plus root metadata; default HF sharding and Metal binary held as alternative format until numeric/architecture equivalence proven.

Diffusers transformer + text_encoder + tokenizer + scheduler + vae and root metadata; standalone transformer/AE safetensors held as unverified alternative format. Gated and non-commercial rights are blocking.
No alternate full checkpoint packaging discovered within this exact repo. Preserve as a conditional Gated original; do not claim it can be compressed to negligible size without loss.

No alternate full checkpoint packaging within repo. High-storage cost compared to compact code models, therefore require same-task measured benefit and distinct preservation rationale before acquisition.
